title: Mathilde: mémoires d'une jeune femme
summary: "Mathilde: mémoires d'une jeune femme" by Eugène Sue is a novel published as a serial between 1840-1841. This early example of French serial fiction follows the memoirs of a virtuous but unhappily married young woman navigating the difficulties of her situation. Blending elements of gothic horror, melodrama, and social commentary, the story features archetypal characters including victims, persecutors, and protectors.
